County worksheets show the amount is about $504,000 above Abacus's original bid totals, mostly from added November staffing.

25-0477.description: This item would extend the county's existing contract with Veolia Water North America-South, LLC for 120 days, from July 6, 2025, through November 3, 2025, for up to about $7.38 million. Veolia operates the North Fulton assets, including three wastewater treatment facilities, all wastewater lift stations and all water pump stations. The extension would let it keep running these facilities without interruption.
25-0477.whyItMayMatter: Wastewater treatment and pumping in the North Fulton service area would continue under the current operator through November 3, 2025.
